name: Pauli X through a phase gadget
summary: A Pauli X on a qubit of a phase gadget flips the sign of the gadget's phase when pushed through.
description:
A NOT gate on one of the qubits of a phase gadget can be pushed through the gadget, at the cost of negating the gadget's phase (and a global phase $e^{i\alpha}$). This is because the NOT flips the parity computed by the gadget, and $\alpha\,(1\oplus y) = \alpha - \alpha y$.

Diagrammatically, the π X-phase is copied through the Z-spider on the qubit wire, fuses into the X-hub of the gadget and is then pushed through the Z-spider of the phase using [π-commutation](../pi-commutation/), negating the phase.
